welcome-discussion.content: Great to have this open space! Working on several video editing workflows and audio mastering setups. Excited to exchange tips with everyone.
Building an automated channel for documentary-style history shorts. The music library and caption tool are saving me hours.

export-settings-workflow.content: For 1080p 60fps Shorts, H.264 Main profile at 12–15 Mbps with 2-pass VBR gives nearly lossless sharpness without file bloat. For 4K long-form, HEVC (H.265) at 35–45 Mbps is ideal.
